caption: The icon and color that Iconize keeps in its data file are now properties of the note.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const dir=app.vault.configDir+'/plugins/obsidian-icon-folder'; if(!(await app.vault.adapter.exists(dir))) await app.vault.adapter.mkdir(dir); await app.vault.adapter.write(dir+'/data.json', "{\"settings\": {\"iconInFrontmatterFieldName\": \"icon\", \"iconColorInFrontmatterFieldName\": \"iconColor\"}, \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Reading list.md\": {\"iconName\": \"LiBookOpen\", \"iconColor\": \"#2f7d5b\"}, \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Trip to Lisbon.md\": \"LiPlane\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Garden.md\": \"LiSprout\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Projects\": \"LiFolderKanban\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Projects/Website.md\": \"LiGlobe\"}"); await app.plugins.plugins['icon-frontmatter-mirror'].mirrorNow(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); for (let i=0;i<60;i++) { const f=app.vault.getFileByPath("Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Reading list.md"); const fm=f && app.metadataCache.getFileCache(f)?.frontmatter; if (fm && fm["icon"]==="LiBookOpen") break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } const f2=app.vault.getFileByPath("Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Reading list.md"); const v=app.metadataCache.getFileCache(f2)?.frontmatter?.["icon"]; if (v!=="LiBookOpen") throw new Error('property '+v); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: A note that already has its own icon value keeps it. The plugin lists it, and you decide.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const dir=app.vault.configDir+'/plugins/obsidian-icon-folder'; if(!(await app.vault.adapter.exists(dir))) await app.vault.adapter.mkdir(dir); await app.vault.adapter.write(dir+'/data.json', "{\"settings\": {\"iconInFrontmatterFieldName\": \"icon\", \"iconColorInFrontmatterFieldName\": \"iconColor\"}, \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Reading list.md\": {\"iconName\": \"LiBookOpen\", \"iconColor\": \"#2f7d5b\"}, \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Trip to Lisbon.md\": \"LiPlane\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Garden.md\": \"LiSprout\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Projects\": \"LiFolderKanban\", \"Icon Frontmatter Mirror/Projects/Website.md\": \"LiGlobe\"}"); await app.plugins.plugins['icon-frontmatter-mirror'].mirrorNow(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); app.plugins.plugins['icon-frontmatter-mirror'].showConflicts(); for (let i=0;i<30 && !document.querySelector('.ifm-conflict-list');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.ifm-conflict-list li')) throw new Error('no conflict row'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro options: two extra properties with a format each, and folder icons in folder notes.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('icon-frontmatter-mirror'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); const h=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.vertical-tab-content .setting-item-name, .vertical-tab-content .setting-group-heading, .vertical-tab-content .setting-item-heading')).find(e => /Extra property 1/.test(e.textContent||'')); if (!h) throw new Error('no Pro rows'); h.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return 'ok'; })()
